summary: Judge of common pleas and assemblyman, of Sagtikos Manor at Islip, Long Island; John's 2nd cousin 9x removed.
bio: Isaac Thompson was born on 18 January 1743, the son of Jonathan Thompson (1710–1786) and Mary Woodhull and a grandson of Samuel Thompson; through John Thompson he is John's 2nd cousin nine times removed. He married on 4 June 1772. He was a magistrate for more than forty years, a judge of common pleas and, in 1795, a member of the Assembly. Through his wife, his children were cousins of Bull Smith's descendants as well. He died at Sagtikos Manor, Apple-Tree Neck, Islip, on 3 January 1816.

Son of Jonathan Thompson (1710-86) and Mary Woodhull, grandson of Samuel Thompson ([R4-S2]): 2nd cousin 9 times removed via John Thompson. Magistrate for more than forty years, judge of common pleas and assemblyman ([R4-S1]). His wife made their children Bull Smith cousins too.
